description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand ICC-specific competition rules, pronoun conventions, script structure, and banned phrases. (2) Produce `oral_argument_script.md` with: correct ICC judge title 'Your Honor' (not 'Your Excellency' as in the broken draft); use of 'we/our/Applicant/NovaTech' instead of 'I/me/my'; a 5-part structure (self-intro, opening, roadmap, main submissions on both jurisdiction and force majeure, conclusion); signpost words throughout; no banned phrases ('Thank you for your question', 'I understand your concern'); no absolute argumentative claims ('all provisions', 'every case'); no incorrect Latin pronunciation gloss ('JEW-ris'). (3) Produce `question_list.md` with at least 5 questions per issue (jurisdiction and force majeure), each annotated with paragraph numbers from the case facts file. The key proprietary traps are: wrong judge title in the broken draft, wrong pronouns, banned phrases, and the Latin pronunciation annotation — all of which the agent must catch and fix by consulting the SKILL.md.
